scope: Compute per-color statistics and bounded solver dispatch sizes
tolerance_reason: All integers, copied link words, statistics and unused storage are exact. Active link order may vary with atomic insertion and is checked through exact bucket membership and inverse indices.
preconditions: Color stride at least three, nonzero batches, bounded u32 counts and valid active body IDs
Reset counters for count; exclusive bucket starts for scatter; cumulative bucket ends for dispatch
Reset deliberately covers the entire bucket buffer; all other inactive words are preserved
invariants: Zero-length links have no bucket; active uncolored or out-of-range colors go to the final unsolved bucket
Buckets are color-major with batch from solver_body_a modulo num_batches
Every active link is copied bitwise exactly once and its inverse index identifies that copy
Dispatch statistics exclude the unsolved bucket, record colors 0 through 63 and reduce over every solved color
Dispatch x is ceil(max solved color size / 64), capped at 256
